name: Sandbox Access
description: Show whether this workspace's run-code can reach the web, or turn that on or off. Off by default: runs reach only PyPI. Turning it on asks the user to approve it in the chat, and works only in AnythingLLM's own chat; never turn it on unless the user asked. A run with web access can't see other workspaces' /shared folders.
author: anything

examples.prompt: Can my scripts fetch web pages?
Let the sandbox reach the web so the script can download today's prices

web.description: "on" or "off"; leave out to only show the current access.

apply.description: true to make the change (the user is asked to approve turning it on); without it, only show what would change.
